SS-DEEPSEEK-HARNESS.Purpose: Expose FLI Core and the canonical skill inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH) as a thin Cordis plugin with DSH-native observation, delivery, lifecycle, skills, and UX.

Scope.SCP-IN-002: Runtime observation surface: successful DSH native `read` results plus deterministic bash read classification through the shared `packages/read-classifier`, via the typed `tools/post-execute` boundary.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Skill registration through native `ctx.skills`; lifecycle identity/reset through reliable DSH Agent/session events.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: Core transport: observed file path -> canonical `fli ancestors`.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: FLI declaration parsing, selector Resolution, graph-boundary inference, graph Discovery, DSH-owned FLI semantics.

Principles.PRIN-001: Functional parity with other supported harnesses; DSH differences are transport, observation, and presentation only.
Principles.PRIN-002: Observation priority: exact DSH native `read` fact first, deterministic shared-classifier bash reads second, unsupported or ambiguous observation never guessed; the DSH tool name `read` is not a FLI Core command.
Principles.PRIN-003: Direct typed DSH extension points over compatibility-hook emulation.

Requirements.REQ-001: `grep`, `glob`, `pwsh`, search/snippet/editor tools are not FLI read events. A `bash` result becomes read observations only when the shared classifier (`packages/read-classifier`) deterministically reports read paths; classifier failures and pathless or ambiguous commands produce no observation and no guessing. A relative classified path without a reliable absolute agent cwd is safely skipped.
Requirements.REQ-002: A successful native `read` becomes a FLI observation only after an unmodified accepted model-visible result exposes canonical `value.path`; failed/blocked/replaced/malformed reads or missing paths produce no observation and no guessing.
Requirements.REQ-003: Reliable DSH `cwd` may resolve a relative transport path but never defines the FLI semantic boundary.
Requirements.REQ-004: Missing reliable Agent/session identity produces no delivery guess and a visible diagnostic.
Requirements.REQ-005: Core observation failure cannot replace or reject the original DSH tool result.
Requirements.REQ-006: Startup|clear resets session; resume preserves; durable `compaction/end` resets context; lifecycle events contribute no FLI semantic system prompt.
Requirements.REQ-007: The canonical FLI skill (`frostline-graph`) is registered through `ctx.skills`; its frontmatter description remains routing authority. Project-local skills (`.agents/skills/`) are not bundle surface.
